confidence_notes: Numbeo's October 2026 Taipei aggregates support the restaurant meal, cappuccino, and domestic draft beer estimates. A recent local cost-of-living estimate supports the cocktail anchor; the wine-glass anchor is a bounded estimate based on the local beer and wine price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and are less certain than food prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy used; food and drink are based on Taipei-specific cost-of-living estimates, while accommodation uses a general Taipei guesthouse and hotel market estimate.
